title: AI Adoption and Consulting: from use cases to software in operation | utxo AG
description: utxo AG works with you to identify the AI use cases with the greatest benefit, assesses them transparently and takes them into operation step by step.
lede: Together with you, we find the use cases that are worth pursuing in your company and take them into operation step by step. The result is software your teams work with every day.

scope.title: What you get
scope.text: We are a software development team. Every recommendation is specific enough to be implemented, and if you wish, we implement it ourselves.

points.name: Use case portfolio
points.text: All use cases from your departments in one overview, assessed by benefit, effort, data and risk.

points.name: Profile per use case
points.text: One page per use case: process today, data sources, people involved, decision points, estimate with a range, and risks.

points.name: Roadmap
points.text: A sequence that fits your organization. Short projects start early, larger ones get under way in parallel.

points.name: Pilot with real data
points.text: The first use case runs as software in your environment, with your data and the people who will work with it later.

points.name: Introduction in the team
points.text: Roles, training and a fixed path for feedback, until the solution is part of everyday work.

example.title: One use case, assessed on one page
example.text: An example: a mechanical engineering company wants to prepare quotes faster. The profile records how the process runs today, which data is available, who is involved and where a person continues to decide. The estimate states a range and the assumptions behind it.
example.note: The profile also shows which form the solution should take: an AI automation, an Agentic CoWorker in the team, a managed agent or custom software.

project.title: How a project runs
project.text: Every use case gets its own estimate. Some are productive within a few weeks, others take months. That is why we plan in waves: short projects deliver results early, and each further one uses what is already in place.

steps.name: Initial conversation
steps.text: We clarify goals, the starting point and who is involved on your side.

steps.name: Use case workshop
steps.text: With your departments, we collect use cases and assess them by benefit, effort, data and risk.

steps.name: Profile and decision
steps.text: Profiles with estimates are prepared for the shortlist. You decide where we begin.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: We develop the first use case and trial it with real data and the people who will use it.

steps.name: Operation and introduction
steps.text: After your approval, the use case goes into operation. We train the teams and start the next wave.

operation.title: Integration and operation
operation.text: A use case has been introduced when the team uses it in everyday work. To get there, we connect the solution to your existing systems, clarify roles and permissions, and stay with the team after the start.

points.name: Existing systems
points.text: Connected to ERP, CRM and DMS, sign-in through your SSO. Your teams keep working in their familiar environment.

points.name: Operation
points.text: utxo AG develops, hosts and monitors the solution. Hosting to your requirements: Germany, EU or on-premises.

points.name: Transparency
points.text: You see how much the solution is used and which feedback is still open. Every action is logged.

points.name: Decisions
points.text: Where it matters, a human approves. Which steps these are is defined together in the profile.

faq.q: How long does it take until a use case is productive?
faq.a: That depends on the use case. Some are productive within a few weeks, others take months, for example when many systems have to be connected or the data situation has to be clarified first. Every profile contains an estimate with a range and the assumptions behind it.

faq.q: Do we receive a concept or a solution in the end?
faq.a: Both. Portfolio, profiles and roadmap are your basis for decisions. utxo AG is a software development team, so the consulting leads to working software: we develop the pilot ourselves and take it into operation with you.

faq.q: Does our data have to be prepared already?
faq.a: No. The data situation is one of the assessment criteria. For each use case, we check which sources exist, in what quality, and what has to be clarified before a pilot. Use cases with good data can start earlier.

faq.q: Who needs to be involved on our side?
faq.a: A person with decision-making authority, the departments the use cases come from, plus IT and data protection. In the pilot, the employees who will later use the solution work with us.

faq.q: How do you handle data protection and the EU AI Act?
faq.a: We prepare the DPA individually for each project. Data is processed only on your instructions, and there is no training with your data. Hosting is defined to your requirements: Germany, EU or on-premises. Our approach is aligned with the EU AI Act: where it matters, a human approves.

faq.q: What happens after the first use case?
faq.a: The roadmap contains the next use cases. Depending on the task, they become AI automations, Agentic CoWorkers or managed agents. When many agents are created, a shared foundation on which they are developed and operated in series becomes worthwhile.
